title: Which bands the Tuxedo men copied from records
summary: Ridgley says they learned from anyone with a popular record, including Dixieland bands and Paul Whiteman.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Bix Beiderbecke: hearing, copying and remembering him

blocks.x: What bands did you listen to on records?
Everyone that had a good record. Everyone that had something that the people liked. That's how we went about it. And we would learn it.
Do you remember the names of any of the bands at all that you listened to?

Well we played, we used to use some of Dixieland, their bands after they started, you see. And different fellas up the line like that would come. We'd get it from anybody. Paul Whiteman, if he had something that the people liked. Anybody, a band that had a good live record was selling good and then the public was liking it and then we would have it to play at our dance, you see, and he'd make a big hit.
